2.text: Ku bwo gukiranuka kwawe unkize untabare,Untegere ugutwi unkize.

3.text: Umbere urutare rw'ubuturo,Aho nzabasha kujya mpungira,Wategetse kunkiza,Kuko ari wowe gitare cyanjye n'igihome kinkingira.

4.text: Mana yanjye, nyarura mu maboko y'umunyabyaha,Nyarura mu maboko y'umunyarugomo ukiranirwa.

5.text: Kuko ari wowe byiringiro byanjye Mwami Uwiteka,Ni wowe nizera uhereye mu buto bwanjye.

6.text: Ni wowe njya nishingikirizaho uhereye mu ivuka ryanjye,Ni wowe wankuye mu nda ya mama,Nzajya ngushima iminsi yose.

7.text: Ndi ishyano ritangaza benshi,Ariko ni wowe buhungiro bwanjye bukomeye.

8.text: Akanwa kanjye kazuzura ishimwe ryawe,N'icyubahiro cyawe umunsi wire.

9.text: Ntunte mu gihe cy'ubusaza,Ntundeke mu gihe intege zanjye zishize.

10.text: Kuko abanzi banjye bamvuga,Abubikira ubugingo bwanjye bajya inama bati

11.text: “Imana yaramuretse,Mumwirukane, mumufate kuko atagira uwo kumukiza.”

12.text: Mana, ntumbe kure,Mana yanjye, tebuka untabare.

13.text: Abanzi b'ubugingo bwanjye bakorwe n'isoni barimbuke,Abashaka kungirira nabi bambikwe ibitutsi n'igisuzuguriro.

14.text: Ariko jyeweho nzajya niringira iteka,Nziyongeranya iteka kugushima.

15.text: Akanwa kanjye kazabara inkuru yo gukiranuka kwawe,N'agakiza kawe umunsi wire,Kuko ntazi umubare wabyo.

16.text: Nzajya aho uri mvuge imirimo ikomeye Umwami Uwiteka yakoze,Nzavuga gukiranuka kwawe wenyine.

17.text: Mana, ni wowe wanyigishije uhereye mu buto bwanjye,Kugeza none ndacyavuga imirimo itangaza wakoze.

18.text: Mana, ntundeke kugeza igihe mera imvi z'ubusaza,Ntarabwira ab'igihe kizaza iby'amaboko yawe,Ntarabwira abazavuka bose gukomera kwawe.

19.text: Mana, urugero rwo gukiranuka kwawe rugera mu ijuru,Ni wowe wakoze ibikomeye,Mana, ni nde uhwanye nawe?

20.text: Ni wowe watweretse ibyago byinshi bikomeye,Uzagaruka utuzure,Utuzamure udukure ikuzimu.

22.text: Nanjye nzagushimisha nebelu,Mana yanjye, nzashima umurava wawe.Ni wowe nzaririmbira ishimwe mbwira inanga,Uwera w'Abisirayeli we.

23.text: Iminwa yanjye izishima cyane,Ubwo nzakuririmbira ishimwe,N'ubugingo bwanjye wacunguye buzishima.

24.text: Kandi ururimi rwanjye ruzavuga gukiranuka kwawe umunsi wire,Kuko abashaka kungirira nabi bakojejwe isoni, bamwajwe.
